#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, h;
    std::cin >> n >> h;

    std::vector<std::vector<long long>> minheight_counts(36, std::vector<long long>(36, 0));
    minheight_counts[0][0] = 1;

    for (int nodes = 1; nodes < 36; ++nodes) {
        for (int minheight = 0; minheight <= nodes; ++minheight) {
            for (int root_node = 1; root_node <= nodes; ++root_node) {
                int left_size = root_node - 1;
                int right_size = nodes - root_node;

                long long left_zero = minheight_counts[left_size][0];
                long long right_zero = minheight_counts[right_size][0];

                long long left_max = minheight_counts[left_size][std::min(minheight - 1, 0)];
                long long right_max = minheight_counts[right_size][std::min(minheight - 1, 0)];

                minheight_counts[nodes][minheight] +=
                    left_zero * right_zero
                    - (left_zero - left_max) * (right_zero - right_max);
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << static_cast<int>(minheight_counts[n][h]) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
